description: A programmable graphics processor sharing one memory pool with the main processor, so a texture budget is a carve-out of main memory rather than a separate video region. It has no reason to carry the PS2 storage modes, so textures are cooked directly uploadable as 32-bit colour. The hardware samples compressed formats natively and would spend far less of that shared pool, but the cook list has no vocabulary for them yet - see docs/nx/PLATFORM.md. 1024 in each axis keeps the largest texture inside one 8 MB read with its asset header. level_textures caps brush materials baked by the level compiler separately from standalone TEXTURE assets, since a level pins every one of its materials for its whole lifetime; 1024 matches the standalone ceiling because a 1080p framebuffer shows the difference.
